display_name: SatIQ 与原生 PAMF-SUP E5 至 E10 同查询配对验证
description: Compare four methods and within-method E5/E10 deltas with paired site and satellite draws.
authorization: User requested PAMF-SUP adapted to SatIQ, no early augmentation, 100 epochs; all arms fully supervised.

data.dataset: Oxford SatIQ Zenodo 8220494, first 1010464 chronological packets
data.representation: Same physical source packets and split. SatIQ uses the 11000-point full preamble; PAMF-SUP native arms use the existing five branches over the 8000-sample common prefix.
data.support_query_ref: Transient source V enrollment K1/16. Independent T (50000) separately staged; no training access.

permissions.claim_scope: Frozen source V comparison. Only 8192 physical samples from L fit partial whitening, exact E5 and E10. No T.

checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed steps 141125 and 282250 for all four methods, irrespective of validation.

execution.launch_owner: One milestone dependency controller and one paired source reader
execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU4; preflight >=4096MiB free and <=2 incumbents after all E10 paths exist.

metric_names: paired satellite-cluster 95% intervals for the K16 AUC and method differences
dimensions: Same E5 and E10 panel, 4 methods, same 8192 L packets, 1000 paired satellite resamples.

rows.method: SatIQ native paired E5 to E10 K16 verification
rows.purpose: Assess change over five additional epochs and same-budget E10 method differences.
rows.seed_notes: Frozen model. Seed determines the L fit subset and fixed source V panels; no augmentation.
rows.scenario: Fixed paper-style and chronological source references and queries.
rows.budget_ref: Same E5 and E10 training budgets for all four source-only methods.

notes: Use the exact same immutable source readout code, fixed pairs and whitening fit samples as E5.
E5 is regenerated to re-use identical satellite bootstrap draws for per-model changes.
Controller waits for selected checkpoints; no intervention in any training process.
